title: 第17章无可抑制的轻颤第18章 离她远点
slug: 共梦后被顶级凶兽们亲哭了
lines: 苏芽芽还准备喊一声。
只见他缓缓睁开眼。
“晚上你就要上场了，现在时间还早，你要是困就睡一会。”
半虎兽人依旧不理她。
看着她，似乎是没听到她说什么。
“你能听懂我说话的，对吧，”苏芽芽走近一步，“为你自己好，趁着有时间抓紧睡一觉，补补精神吧。”
她说完，没有半点停留，再多说一句的意思，就去忙自己的事。
半虎兽人听着旁边的动静，渐渐松开了掐紧的掌心。
她正在整理着杂物，按照大小排序好。
苏芽芽浑然不觉，身后那道紧紧黏在她身上的目光，从戒备转入热烈。
苏芽芽没有那么多烂好心来劝说半兽人。
且不说他们根本就不熟。
就他们这关系，估计半兽人对斗兽场的大半恨意，都会倾注在管理员身上。
她只要做到自己问心无愧就可以了。
但是多说无益。
不如省点力气，做点别的。
按照斗兽场的惯例，如果今天晚上，这个半兽人能胜出归来，笼子里的设备会随之升级优待。
比如给笼子垫上毯子，让半兽人睡得舒服些。
连续胜出几场，待遇会随之升高。
半兽人会在这一层层的优待中，品尝到胜利带来的好处，因此愿意主动精进自己的杀招。
从而给贵宾们带来更加刺激的场面。
苏芽芽埋头准备接下来要装进笼子里的毯子。
这个阶段从物料处领来的毯子们，都不知道经历过多少半兽人使用过，有股特别难闻的味道。
苏芽芽隔着编织袋都能被熏个大跟头。
以后她还要守着这个半兽人的笼子。
可这个味道多闻一会儿，她都要吐出来了。
她戴严口罩，麻溜地把袋子扯掉。
打开水龙头，用高压水枪冲着毯子，然后狠狠用长杆刷，刷洗着这个毯子。
很快，她的额头渗出了一层潮汗。
苏芽芽浑然没有意识到，出了汗，身体散发出的桃子味道更重了几分。
身后笼子里的半虎兽人无可自控地深吸了一口气。
他的目光幽幽地盯住了苏芽芽的后背。
content_en:
Su Yaya was ready to shout.
I saw him slowly opening his eyes.
"You're going to play tonight. It's still early now. If you're sleepy, take a nap."
The half-tiger orc still ignored her.
Looking at her, it seemed that he didn't hear what she said.
"You can understand what I'm saying, right," Su Yaya took a step closer, "For your own good, take a nap while you have time to replenish your energy."
After she finished speaking, she didn't stop for a moment and went about her own business without any intention of saying another word.
The half-tiger orc listened to the movement next to him and gradually loosened his grip on his palms.
She was sorting through the miscellaneous items and sorting them by size.
Su Yaya was completely unaware that the gaze behind her that was glued to her changed from alert to enthusiastic.
Su Yaya didn't have such bad intentions to persuade the orcs.
Not to mention that they are not familiar with each other at all.
Based on their relationship, it is estimated that most of the orcs' hatred for the Colosseum will be directed towards the administrator.
She just needs to have a clear conscience.
But there is no point in saying more.
It's better to save some energy and do something else.
According to the practice of the Colosseum, if the orc can come back victorious tonight, the equipment in the cage will be upgraded and treated accordingly.
For example, put a blanket on the cage to make the orcs sleep more comfortably.
If you win several games in a row, your salary will increase accordingly.
Orcs will taste the benefits of victory in these layers of preferential treatment, so they are willing to take the initiative to improve their killing moves.
This will bring a more exciting scene to the VIPs.
Su Yaya buried her head in preparing the blankets that would be put into the cage next.
The blankets received from the materials department at this stage had been used by countless orcs, and they had a particularly unpleasant smell.
Su Yaya could be smoked even though she was in a woven bag.
She will have to guard this orc's cage from now on.
But if she smelled this smell for a while longer, she would spit it out.
She put on a tight mask and quickly pulled off the bag.
Turn on the faucet, use a high-pressure water gun on the blanket, and then use a long brush to scrub the blanket.
Soon, a layer of sweat broke out on her forehead.
Su Yaya didn't realize that she was sweating, and the smell of peach from her body was a little stronger.
The half-tiger orc in the cage behind him took a deep breath uncontrollably.
His eyes were fixed on Su Yaya's back.
title_en: Chapter 17 Uncontrollable Trembling Chapter 18 Stay away from her
